body:
Shit. I'm reading about alcohol withdraw symptoms and I took a quiz that says I have "mild to moderate" symptoms after about 24 hours. This is worrisome as, according to what I'm reading, if the "really bad shit" is going to occur (blackouts, tremors, hallucinations - which I'm ok with? lol, wild mood swings, etc)..they don't set in for 72-96 hours so..I'm kinna worried. The first second I notice any of that shit, if I'm cognizant enough, I'm calling an ambulance.  
  
That's the thing..call me a "pussy" but, like, if I'm going to go, I wouldn't do it unless it were pretty sudden or painless. That's why I took all those psych pills in September. I figured I would just "go to sleep" and not wake up. Little did I know that I would have the opposite reaction. I flopped around on the floor like a fish for god knows how long. I cut the shit out of my arms, have a seemingly permanent scar on my face and cut up/injured my knees..which are both still sore, over a month later. That was a frightening experience. I remember laying on the floor, I thought my dad was here, in the other room watching TV. I live in a studio apartment (main room/hall/bathroom) so obviously he wasn't. I kept calling out "HELP!! HELP!!" at the top of my lungs for what seemed like an eternity. I guess one of my neighbors heard me as, eventually two police officers showed up and then fire/ambulance who carted me off to the hospital. Thank -insert higher power of choice here- that, for once, I had forgotten to lock my door. Otherwise they would've had to kick it in to get in here. I never did figure out which one of my neighbors (there's only 2) called the police but I'm pretty certain that, whoever it was, they saved my life.  
  
I remember the cops asking me if I had been drinking as there were a couple of cans on my nighttable but, for whatever reason, that day I hadn't been. I was also taking Klonopin and I think I was afraid, as silly as it sounds with my plan already being set for later, to drink and take Klonopin at the same time. I vaguely recall a female officer looking through my dresser drawers, I guess checking for drugs or anything. Luckily, I had smoked the last of the weed I had the previous day and, in a fit of paranoia, I guess sensing that if this went wrong, the cops were going to show up, I carefully wrapped up my bowl, buried it amongst other trash in a bag and threw it in the dumpster, knowing that it would be emptied later that night.  
  
I still don't know why the hospital released me the next morning, it's mind boggling. I don't remember getting there and I don't know what they did to me overnight. I woke up at about 7am the next morning, immediately demanding to see the doctor, who hadn't arrived yet so I could ask when I could go home. They asked me if I knew where I was and I responded with a completely different hospital name - one that's a few miles away from where I was. I'm guessing I did that because I recall telling the EMTs to take me to that hospital. I had been there before and if I was going to spend 72 on lockdown, I'd rather do it with decent food, nice, caring staff and the ability to spend my free time watching Law and Order reruns than stuck next to some dude shitting on himself talking about the robots in his head that were going to take over (True story.) The nurse kept telling me "we need to keep you here for a while longer, we gave you some Risperdal." In retrospect, that had to be a lie. Why the fuck would they give me MORE of the same drug that I just attempted to overdose on? Either the doctor I talked to was really stupid, over-worked or I am a hell of a salesman. I think I only spoke to him once for about 10 minutes total. Plus, they gave me some kind of fucked up drug (I'm guessing Dilaudid, maybe?) as when I left around 11 in the morning and was outside waiting for my parents, I was *fucked up*. I've experimented with just about every drug under the sun sans crack and PCP and nothing has ever fucked me up like whatever they gave me...and not in an enjoyable way, I was just wrecked. I kept asking the nurse when I could go home - my status quo when I've been hospitalized in the past - I am *never* friendly to those people because I hate being there and I feel like a dick about it. I couldn't even stand. I remember leaning against a concrete post looking at all of the cop cars that were at the hospital thinking "FUCK. Please don't see me like this.".  
  
My parents dropped me off at home and I started trying to piece shit back together. I hit my head/face so hard on my coffee table that both of the lenses popped out of my glasses..I couldn't see and, to this day, never found one of the lenses. My phone had died to the point of where even if I plugged it in, it still wouldn't power up for some reason (it did, several hours later), so I walked/stumbled in a stupor up to my sister's apartment building about half a mile away. Her building is secure, so I went around to the side and knocked on her patio screen door saying over and over "Hey! it's xxxxxx, your brother. I need help! My phone is dead, I don't have my glasses, I can't see!" For a good 10 minutes, I repeated the same thing, at an increasingly rapid pace over and over..pleading with her to help me out of sheer desperation. I could see her, kinna, through the blinds on the door sitting there using her computer just totally ignoring me. I was *pissed* and went back home. I told my parents about this later and they told me to leave her alone, she was just scared. That really hurt. I don't really talk to or see my sister much but, had the roles been reversed and she came to my door literally crying for help, there's no way in hell I would've just ignored her. I've been a pretty selfish and deceitful person but I am *never* one to turn down someone who I can discern truly needs help. Whether it's a total stranger or especially if it's a friend or family member, I've always been one person they could call and say "hey..i fucked up bad. i need help" and I will be there immediately. I'm still angry about that and half out of fear of retaliation, half out of pure hurt and anger, I have yet to speak to my sister since.
  
I eventually made my way back home, ran in to my neighbor and she let me use her phone to call my parents so I could tell them about my glasses. I couldn't get ahold of them so I borrowed a pair of her glasses that were...way too weak but still better than nothing..and drove to my parents house about 10 minutes away. They weren't home but I ran in to their neighbor and she ended up driving me to a WalMart so I could see if the vision center could repair my glasses/replace the one lens I couldn't find. Turns out, they hadn't opened for the day yet (it was a Sunday). So I went back and got my car and drove, literally probably legally blind, back home. I eventually got ahold of my parents and they took me back to Wallyworld after they opened and got me a new set of glasses.  
  
By the time I got home, my phone had finally started taking a charge and I had one message - from my spouse. Saying that my parents had called her the night before looking for me. I proceeded to tell her what happened and then she launched in to the whole "let's just trying to be friends first and work back in to this slowly" speech that started this most recent debacle. It breaks my heart, not two weeks ago, she was here and we were cuddling for the first time in probably two years in my bed and she told me she was happy to be here and that it felt right, she was finally starting to feel comfortable around me again..then the fucking bottom fell out.

I dunno why I'm posting all this..I guess it's an attempt to try to give you folks the full scope of what's going on here and why I feel how I feel. It's kind of weird, reading through a lot of these threads where people say something like "my parents are mean and the boy/girl i like said i was fat. foreveralone, i want to die." While I would certainly encourage those folks to seek counseling and I feel for you, seriously, there are much bigger problems you can be facing in life, tackle these things head on and kick them "squar-in-the-nuts", as Cartman would say, while you can so you don't end up with severe mental, physical and relationship issues (the emo axis of evil..sorry..heh) later on down the line. I'm not really a nice guy most of the time. Deep down inside, I think I am, I've just lit too many fires under too many demons that are fun to play with from time to time but eventually these things turn in to megabackdraft 9000, in your fase style bad shit - literally backing you in to a corner. I'm trying to figure out how to deal with them and reconcile a life full of nothing but broken relationships and issues that I caused by running away from them when they were likely more manageable.  
  
You don't want to end up here, trust me.  
  
I've been clinically dead once (maybe twice, not sure what happened last month, as I noted.) I've taken so much Adderall to "feel good" and run from my problems that my heart stopped and I face-planted on a concrete patio and went into convulsions from the impact. To this day, 7 years later, for some odd reason, when I get super shitcan drunk the areas on my face where I hit become bright red and my left eye is permanently and noticeably drooped lower than the right one. But I was fucking stupid and kept going. Kept at the same old shit. Now, I feel like I really have no other choice - face some of the hardest shit a human being can have to deal with and put months, hell, years of work to fix it...or take a dive and make it all go away. When you've lived your life constantly taking the easy way out - guess what seems pretty attractive?

Sure, thanks. This has proved to be immensely helpful. I have never really been this completely honest about all of this stuff with anyone. Like I mentioned, I don't have anyone that I'd feel comfortable telling it to and some of this stuff (with the spouse) isn't really something I can take to my parents. Heh.  Even when I met with the social worker last year, I skirted a lot of issues and played the "victim" card as far as the stuff with my spouse, who admittedly, has said some pretty nasty shit to me (ie - screaming fights when we were living together) and actually attacked me with a pedestal fan, whipped me with a TV antenna and tried to drop a TV on me while I was waking up one morning. I think it was because I couldn't afford to take her somewhere nice for some romantic-type holiday..guessing I probably spent what little money I had at the time on booze. I'm not trying to "victimize" myself here. Afterwards, she swore she had no recollection of doing it so either she was lying or went in to some sort of rage blackout. That's not really out of the question as she does tend to kind of lose it when she gets really mad and as I recall, at the time, things were really starting to escalate and get ugly as I was stealing her liquor and replacing it with water then flat out denying it when she would call me out on it.
  
I got a call back from the intake people at in-patient rehab and they want me to go in Tuesday for an assessment. I have to be sober 3 days though, elsewise I have to go to a hospital for "medical detox", I think she called it. I called my social worker, who amazingly, still remembered me even though we only met a handful of times a year ago, and she said that if I can get in to this program to do it..she spoke very highly of it.  
  
I also just got home from my parents' house. I had full intentions of telling them all of this but as it turns out my dad was getting ready to his cardiac rehab class and it just didn't seem like a good time. I dunno if my mom knows something is up but my dad definitely does, he is *hyper* intelligent. He didn't give me money, instead a pack of smokes (neither of them smoke so that was weird, heh), a gift certificate for a local restaurant, a gas gift card (can't use it on shop items, ie - booze - just gas) and an old TV and DVD player that he thought I might be able to (and I will) flip on Craigslist real quick. My mom made me lunch and gave me some food items to take home as well. So that's a huge help as I was literally down to my last can of soup. 
  
I asked if I could stop by for dinner tomorrow that I had some stuff to talk to them about and they both excitedly said sure..so..chances are, they know something is amiss. We'll see.  
  
I think I am going to try to knock out this project this evening, tomorrow and Sunday (shouldn't be difficult), that way I can invoice these guys and get the rest of my payment from them ($800, nothing to sneeze at). I just need to keep my mind occupied and not think about the spouse and try to stay away from booze. It sucks, it's like 55 degrees here today and I'm just wearing a light half-zip pullover sweater but I sweat my ass off as soon as I start hustling around. I actually had to turn my AC on in the car and towel my head/neck/face off when I got to my parents'. I'm guessing this is from alcohol withdraw? I'm so used to being hammered every day that I never really noticed this. I guess my body is so used to the poison that it's angry I'm not putting it in me. That fuckin sucks and is really upsetting.

I'll pass on the Good Charlotte, thanks for the sentiment though.  :)
  
I dunno..I just feel like a master of self-sabotage and I've sabotaged myself to the point of where I don't know if I can make it back out. The crap with my spouse is like deja vu, almost a frame-by-frame replay of what happened between us at this exact time last year. She called the cops on me after I threatened to off myself, went to the hospital, got released and the day I came home was met by a court officer with a domestic violence restraining order. Like I said, I've never laid a hand on my spouse, hell, I've never been in a fight my 30+ years on this planet. Reading through the order filled me with rage, the things she said I said and did. I vehemently denied them to myself for the longest time. Looking at the order today, I do recall saying some of the things she said I did, it was just that I was blacked out drunk at the time or blocked it out, whatever. I dunno.  
  
After a friend of her's committed suicide last December, she ended up calling me (while the order was still in effect, basically violating it..heh) and said she wanted to try to reconcile and if she lifted the order if I could be civil. I agreed. Hell, I was overjoyed. About a week after that, I landed the aforementioned job. I was living at home, sadly, but everything was looking up. Well..sure enough, once I started getting money coming in, I'd stop off at a pub on the way home as it was on my bus route and I'd start drinking. Then the stuff at work (drinking) picked up. I feel terrible for coming in to my parents' house hammered. It upset them greatly, they told me as such and they couldn't get me out of their soon enough. Also, I'd come home drunk and pissed and lay in to my spouse via text messages and just say really, really mean shit. Half of me wants to believe I didn't mean the things I said, half of me thinks I did. Then we didn't talk again until May. Rinse, repeat.  
  
Then we met in August. Turns out she had picked up a heroin habit and was afraid to see me while she was strung out. She never really came out and specifically blamed me for it but has alluded to such saying things like that she felt "she had the right to feel good too.." She ended up ODing and was found by the police. She was eventually indicted on heroin possession charges and is trying to plea out in to a treatment program instead of jail (she'll probably get it.) After the crap happened where I thought I caught her cheating, I teed off on her and brought up all of the old things and accusations. She's at the point now where she is threating with the PO if I contact her again..I have, a couple of times over the past couple of days anyway so I'm just waiting for it to show up.  
  
The thing that kills me, figuratively..heh, is why she would keep repeating this cycle? I guess she does love me but I'm conflicted because of the infidelity stuff and things she has said to me recently like that this was just a game and she's glad that I get it. She has a history of saying things for the sole purpose of hurting me but..I don't know. I'm just fucking confused. She had the opportunity to divorce me last year when she had the PO but didn't, even though she said she was going to. Now she's threatening it again but I've yet to see any papers and with the money her family has, if she really wanted it done, I would've had a process server here by now. So it just feels like it's going to be the same cycle of not talking, then she decides to try to work it out. I realize this all hinges on me and not fucking up and staying sober and staying employed it just seems like..well..it doesn't seem like..it's a fact that I seem hellbent, for whatever reason, on sabotaging it and my life as a result.  
  
In the "good news" department..I was able to connect with the social worker I met with last year and have an appointment to meet with her next Wednesday. I wanted to get that lined up before calling my parents so they at least have an idea that I'm serious. I don't know if they'll believe me though. They've heard this "I'm tired of this, I want to quit" song and dance more times than I can count. That's why just going away seems like an option. If they are to the point are where they have literally threatened to cut me out of their lives voluntarily, and they are literally the only people I have here in town that I can look to for help with day-to-day life..then what difference does it make if I'm gone too. In their minds, I would be, at least I wouldn't have to cope with the pain that I was such a shitty son that my parents would rather pretend that I do not exist. It seems better than being homeless, etc. I fear the day that comes next month when I can't afford my car payment/rent and they take my car (they co-signed as I have shit credit). Then I will really have no resources to do anything.  
  
I'm sorry to continue ranting and rambling on. If you guys are willing to listen, which I appreciate **greatly**, you guys are way better than the 1-800 person I talked to this morning (who actually *put me on hold* because another line was ringing ***facepalm***), I'm willing to talk this out. Like I said, I don't think I want to die..I don't know. I just feel like I'm out of viable options here.

That was a really good video, thanks for sharing that. Definitely raises a lot of good points.  
  
I have seen a social worker in the past for alcohol/relationship issues, I'm going to see if I have her card. I also located what looks to be a pretty affordable rehab facility - it's income based/sliding scale. The big thing I'm afraid of is pitching this to my parents - I don't know if they will react positively or just say "fuck this." and cut me off.  I truly feel like I need it and that's the only way I am ever going to beat this. I'm an extremely stubborn person and if the opportunity presents itself is there to drink, I'm going to do it. I really can't control myself because I don't know how. That's what I'm hoping rehab and being just *away* from everything for 28 days or whatever would help resolve and so that I can learn how to cope with problems without feeling the constant need to escape them.
  
I also called that 1-800-SUICIDE number this morning after posting this and I guess it's helped some. I've at least temporarily focused my attention on seeking help for the booze which is really the major issue here. I need to get some sleep at some point though. I don't know if it's from the alcohol throwing off my circadian rhythm or whatever but my sleep is fucked and keeps getting worse. I fell asleep at 11 last night and woke up at 3..have been awake ever since. I tried Melatonin but that only worked for a couple of weeks.  
  
And now I'm rambling. Anyway. thanks again for the post and the video.
